strongest_objection: The declared type and the map's own boundary claim disagree, and the of-sentence loses. `of` says the gate is compelled to buy "from those who pass it"; the boundary claim admits any purchase "compelled by the gate's position as gate". Under the of-sentence, Queue with an exit (the port buys from the longshore union, which passes nothing; the ships pass), Hour that must be manned (the agency nurse is not the patient), Celibate gate (the families that supply priests owe the church nothing and pass no gate), and the airline case of Tenure by consumption are nonmembers, and Built to be bought sells from the one party that refuses to pass. Under the boundary claim they are all members, and the map is better for them. The fix is to the of-sentence, not the items: "A mechanism by which a party holding a chokepoint is nonetheless compelled, by its position as gate, to buy from whoever can read the compulsion, usually the passers themselves and sometimes the suppliers of what the gate must have to remain a gate, named with why the gate must buy, the carrier that holds the clock, what a seller who sees the compulsion can extract, and how the compulsion lapses, since the clock may be held by a higher gate, by the passers, or by the gate's own ledger, tenure, mandate, or habit." Beyond that, three item clauses assert more than the cases support (a seller-less water right, central-bank purchase equated with inflation, a must-buy that omits the gate's option to copy the bypass), and three edge labels carry cases that do not demonstrate their own antecedent, most seriously Crown → Must-take, where the 1893 repeal preceded the bond sales it is said to have been decided at. None of this collapses an item; every repair is local.

items.item: Tenure by consumption: the gate keeps its gate only while it uses it, so it must buy a use, as the airline flies empty planes to keep a slot under the eighty-percent rule, the western farmer floods a field to keep a water right that lapses with non-use, and the designated market maker buys at its bid in a falling market because standing ready to buy is the condition of the seat; the carrier is the condition written into the tenure, the seller extracts by supplying the use, the codeshare partner, the thirsty crop, the seller hitting the bid, and the compulsion lapses when the condition is waived, as slot rules were in 2020, or reaches the escape written into it, since the market maker's duty ends at the widest permitted quote and the trading halt; not deal-flow-attractors' counterparty of last resort, whose always is chosen and priced by the node, since here the always is rent on the seat and its ceiling is written by the landlord.
items.why: The type requires a seller who sees the compulsion and extracts. The water-right case has no seller: the farmer floods a field and buys the use from no one, and 'the thirsty crop' is not a party. The airline case's seller is thin but real (codeshare partners, discounted fares). Replace the water right with a tenure whose use must be bought from a seller who can read the deadline, and keep the farmer at the edge of the type where it belongs.
items.repair: Tenure by consumption: the gate keeps its gate only while it uses it, so it must buy a use, as the airline flies near-empty planes to keep a slot under the eighty-percent rule, the spectrum licensee builds out towers by the license's construction deadline or forfeits the band, and the designated market maker buys at its bid in a falling market because standing ready to buy is the condition of the seat; the carrier is the condition written into the tenure, the seller extracts by supplying the use, the codeshare partner and the discounted passenger, the tower contractor who reads the buildout date, the seller hitting the bid, and the compulsion lapses when the condition is waived, as slot rules were in 2020, or reaches the escape written into it, since the market maker's duty ends at the widest permitted quote and the trading halt; the western farmer who floods a field to keep a water right that lapses with non-use is the limit where the gate buys the use from no one and nothing is extracted, so it sits at the edge of the type rather than inside it; not deal-flow-attractors' counterparty of last resort, whose always is chosen and priced by the node, since here the always is rent on the seat and its ceiling is written by the landlord.

items.item: Crown at the auction: the sovereign that taxes and coins must still roll its debt on the day it matures, so the gate of money buys money from the dealers at whatever the auction says, as Charles V bought the imperial election with Fugger loans and the gilt market removed a British prime minister inside seven weeks; the carrier is the maturity calendar, which the sovereign wrote and cannot move, the seller extracts yield and, past yield, policy, and the compulsion lapses only into the central bank's purchase of the same paper, which is to say into inflation, so the escape is the borrower's own mint and that door is priced by a different crowd; not ordinary borrowing, since here the buyer of last resort and the borrower are one body with two names.
items.why: 'lapses only into the central bank's purchase of the same paper, which is to say into inflation' promotes a contested claim to fact (a decade of central-bank purchases 2009 to 2020 was not paid in inflation) and omits the other escape, a primary surplus, which is a purchase of money from the taxpayers instead of the dealers. The mechanism survives; the clause needs its modality back.
items.repair: Crown at the auction: the sovereign that taxes and coins must still roll its debt on the day it matures, so the gate of money buys money from the dealers at whatever the auction says, as Charles V bought the imperial election with Fugger loans and the gilt market removed a British prime minister inside seven weeks; the carrier is the maturity calendar, which the sovereign wrote and cannot move, the seller extracts yield and, past yield, policy, and the compulsion lapses only into a primary surplus, which buys the money from the taxpayers instead, or into the central bank's purchase of the same paper, which moves the price from the dealers to the currency's holders and is paid in inflation when and only when they decide it is, so the escape is the borrower's own mint and that door is priced by a different crowd; not ordinary borrowing, since here the buyer of last resort and the borrower are one body with two names.

items.item: Built to be bought: a gate whose franchise is worth more than any single bypass must buy each credible bypass at the bypass's price, so a bypass is built to be sold to the gate it threatens, as the photo app with no revenue sold for a billion to the network it would have drained; the carrier is the franchise value and the gate's ability to see the bypass coming, the seller extracts a price set by the gate's loss rather than the bypass's earnings, and the compulsion lapses when the bypasses become a class too numerous to buy or when a higher gate forbids the purchase, with the extraction capped at the price where the gate would rather be bypassed; not first-mover-forecloses' acquisition of a bottleneck, which is the mover's move, since here it is the gate's compulsion and the builder's plan.
items.why: 'must buy each credible bypass' omits the escape that actually caps the extraction: the gate can copy the bypass, as the network cloned the ephemeral story after the bypass refused three billion. The seller's price is the lesser of the gate's loss and the gate's cost to copy, and a bypass built to be sold must be one the gate cannot clone. As written the item overstates the compulsion and misprices the extraction.
items.repair: Built to be bought: a gate whose franchise is worth more than any single bypass must buy each credible bypass it cannot copy, at the bypass's price, so a bypass is built to be sold to the gate it threatens, as the photo app with no revenue sold for a billion to the network it would have drained; the carrier is the franchise value and the gate's ability to see the bypass coming, the seller extracts a price set by the gate's loss rather than the bypass's earnings, and the compulsion lapses when the bypasses become a class too numerous to buy, when a higher gate forbids the purchase, or when the gate can copy the bypass faster than the bypass can grow, as the network copied the ephemeral story it had failed to buy, so the extraction is capped at the lesser of the gate's loss and the gate's cost to copy, and a bypass built to be sold must be one the gate cannot clone; not first-mover-forecloses' acquisition of a bottleneck, which is the mover's move, since here it is the gate's compulsion and the builder's plan.

items.item: Papered house: when the crowd is the evidence, the gate buys the crowd, as the theatre gives away the first week's seats so critics see a full house and actors play to one, the conference comps the front rows, and the tuition-dependent college discounts the freshman class until the dormitory is full; the carrier is the reviewer who counts heads, the seller extracts a free seat or a merit scholarship whose merit is the calendar, since aid rises after the first of May, and the compulsion lapses when the reviews are in or the class is full; not shelf bought first, which buys supply so that buyers come, since here the gate buys buyers so that suppliers, critics, and other buyers come, and the two together form a fork over which side to buy.
items.why: The ledger rejected the gallery bidding on its own artist as what-a-price-does' Price for the stranger's eyes, then admitted the theatre giving away seats so critics count heads, which is the same purchase with the price spent to zero. The item is a member (the count of bodies, not the recorded number, is the evidence), but it must face that neighbor, and at present it faces only Shelf bought first.
items.repair: Papered house: when the crowd is the evidence, the gate buys the crowd, as the theatre gives away the first week's seats so critics see a full house and actors play to one, the conference comps the front rows, and the tuition-dependent college discounts the freshman class until the dormitory is full; the carrier is the reviewer who counts heads, the seller extracts a free seat or a merit scholarship whose merit is the calendar, since aid rises after the first of May, and the compulsion lapses when the reviews are in or the class is full; not shelf bought first, which buys supply so that buyers come, since here the gate buys buyers so that suppliers, critics, and other buyers come, and the two together form a fork over which side to buy; not what-a-price-does' price for the stranger's eyes, where the recorded number is the evidence and the gate buys the number, since here the bodies are the evidence and the price is spent down to zero to get them.

items.item: News hole: a gate with a fixed slot on a fixed clock must fill the slot whether or not anything arrived, so the seller who knows the slow day sells into the hole, as the press release runs on the Sunday the paper had nothing and the cable channel buys a panel to fill the hour; the carrier is the format, the seller extracts placement and the gate's editorial stamp at a price of zero, and the compulsion lapses when the slot becomes elastic, as the web page did, and returns wherever a fixed slot is reinstated, the daily show, the weekly newsletter, the quarterly call; not the shelf, which fills once, since the hole reopens on every tick.
items.why: News hole and Stamp with an expiry are the two closest items on the map (a fixed slot on a fixed clock; a stamp on a calendar) and neither discriminates against the other. They separate: the hole cannot be left empty and can only be substituted, the stamp can print 'no award'. A format that fixes the count (the forty under forty) is a hole wearing a stamp and decays by dilution, not under-lending. The item should say so.
items.repair: News hole: a gate with a fixed slot on a fixed clock must fill the slot whether or not anything arrived, so the seller who knows the slow day sells into the hole, as the press release runs on the Sunday the paper had nothing and the cable channel buys a panel to fill the hour; the carrier is the format, the seller extracts placement and the gate's editorial stamp at a price of zero, and the compulsion lapses when the slot becomes elastic, as the web page did, and returns wherever a fixed slot is reinstated, the daily show, the weekly newsletter, the quarterly call; not the shelf, which fills once, since the hole reopens on every tick; not the stamp with an expiry, which can print no award and leave the year empty, since the hole can only be substituted and never left empty, so a stamp whose format fixes the count, the forty under forty, is a hole wearing a stamp and decays by dilution rather than by under-lending.

items.item: Stamp with an expiry: a gate whose currency is its stamp must spend the stamp on a calendar or the stamp is forgotten, so the annual prize must be given, and publishers time books to the eligibility window and lobby for a strong year to be split; the carrier is the calendar and the memory of the audience, the seller extracts the stamp's full value in a slow year at the price of a strong one, and the compulsion lapses the first time the gate withholds and survives, as the fiction Pulitzer did in 2012, which showed the must to be custom; speculative that the withholding then raises the stamp, since a stamp that can be withheld certifies more than one that cannot; not deal-flow-attractors' name others need, which decays by over-lending, since here the stamp decays by under-lending and the two decays meet at a rate the gate does not know.
items.why: Tested as the right side of my neighbor pair against News hole; survives on the withholding escape the hole lacks. Speculation is marked. Kept as the map's wild end without domestication.

items.item: Shelf bought first: a two-sided gate must buy the side whose absence the other side can see, so the platform pays for content before it has viewers, as the new console pays for exclusives, the streaming service commissions originals to open, and the marketplace seeds sellers with fee holidays; the carrier is the visibility of the empty side, the seller of the first shelf extracts a launch fee that the thousandth seller cannot, and the compulsion lapses at thickness, when any one item on the shelf becomes replaceable and the fee goes to zero; not deal-flow-attractors' shelf that draws both sides, which is what a full shelf does to what arrives, since here the question is what the gate must pay to fill it and which side it must fill first.
items.why: The most respectable item on the map (the subsidy side of a two-sided market is textbook), and the closest thing to a longer-safer-list entry; it earns its place only as the other tine of the fork with Papered house, and it does that work. Kept on that ground.

neighbor_test.left: News hole: a gate with a fixed slot on a fixed clock must fill the slot whether or not anything arrived, so the seller who knows the slow day sells into the hole, as the press release runs on the Sunday the paper had nothing and the cable channel buys a panel to fill the hour; the carrier is the format, the seller extracts placement and the gate's editorial stamp at a price of zero, and the compulsion lapses when the slot becomes elastic, as the web page did, and returns wherever a fixed slot is reinstated, the daily show, the weekly newsletter, the quarterly call; not the shelf, which fills once, since the hole reopens on every tick.
neighbor_test.right: Stamp with an expiry: a gate whose currency is its stamp must spend the stamp on a calendar or the stamp is forgotten, so the annual prize must be given, and publishers time books to the eligibility window and lobby for a strong year to be split; the carrier is the calendar and the memory of the audience, the seller extracts the stamp's full value in a slow year at the price of a strong one, and the compulsion lapses the first time the gate withholds and survives, as the fiction Pulitzer did in 2012, which showed the must to be custom; speculative that the withholding then raises the stamp, since a stamp that can be withheld certifies more than one that cannot; not deal-flow-attractors' name others need, which decays by over-lending, since here the stamp decays by under-lending and the two decays meet at a rate the gate does not know.
neighbor_test.separating_case: A magazine's annual forty-under-forty list beside the fiction Pulitzer in a weak year. Both are fixed slots on a fixed clock whose gate must spend a stamp or be forgotten. The list names forty regardless, because the format fixes the count and a page cannot run blank; the prize board can print no award and did in 2012. So the hole's only escape is substitution (filler, reruns, elasticity) and the stamp's is withholding, and the two decay differently: the list by dilution of each name, the prize by under-lending. They do not collapse, but the map never puts them face to face, which is why News hole is repaired to carry the discriminator.

boundary_case: The owner of an essential facility under a duty to deal, the pipeline that must carry a rival's gas at a tariffed rate, the patent holder bound to license on FRAND terms: a chokepoint, compelled by a higher gate, with sellers who read the compulsion. It is out, and the ruling is instructive: the compulsion there is to sell to those who pass, and the map is about compelled buying; the passers extract by being served, not by being bought from. The mirror shows what the type really is, compelled purchase rather than compelled dealing, and it names the sibling map this one implies, tollgates that must sell. A tempting member the map lacks sits exactly on the seam: the clearinghouse whose rulebook compels it to take over a defaulted member's book and sell it into an auction where the surviving members, who are the passers, bid knowing the gate must both buy and sell that day.

seriation.note: Endpoints are real (a writ only its author can repeal; a custom one survived refusal ends) and the hinge at Queue with an exit is the map's best teaching. Two repairs. First, the note places Crown at the auction before the hinge among clocks 'held by someone else (the dealers)', but the item's own carrier is 'the maturity calendar, which the sovereign wrote', a ledger the gate holds, so either the note's account of Crown or its position is wrong; the honest reading is that the calendar is the gate's own and the price is the dealers', which makes Crown the first item after the hinge, not the third before it. Second, the claimed consequential adjacency Vehicle that must move → Spec that must be brought says 'along this stretch the seller's extraction is postponed rather than destroyed', but the Spec item says a second proposal 'destroys the seller's extraction', and Spec has no customary date to survive; the adjacency as explained contradicts the item. What that stretch actually teaches is different and better: from Vehicle to Spec to Celibate to Stamp, the compulsion to buy survives while the extraction is postponed (Vehicle), destroyed (Spec), permanent (Celibate), and finally revealed to be the whole of the compulsion (Stamp). Celibate gate's clock, mortality, is held by no one, and the note should say so rather than fold it into 'the gate's own mandate'.

edges.why: The passage between levels is real and the antecedent can fail (a one-off purchase such as Built to be bought breeds no slot market). But the two cases sit at different levels: rider slots are rationed by leadership, which is the gate, while night shifts are swapped among nurses, who are the sellers. The label says the sellers trade the right among themselves and then gives a case where the gate rations it.
edges.repair_label: If a compelled purchase recurs on a calendar and can be seen, the right to be the one bought becomes a good in its own right, rationed by the gate where the gate holds the roster, as leadership rations rider slots, and traded among the sellers where they hold it, as nurses swap the night shift, so a compulsion at the gate's level arrives at the sellers' level as a market in slots whose owner is whoever keeps the roster.

edges.why: The dependency is the map's best structural claim (the most structural compulsion lapses through a compulsion on its author), but the case does not demonstrate the antecedent. The 1893 repeal came in November; the bond sales that refilled the gold reserve began in 1894 and 1895. The gold drained at the Treasury's redemption window, not at the auction, so what priced the writ was the crown's promise to redeem on demand, which is a Tenure-by-consumption door rather than the auction door. The label asserts 'repealed on the day the auction leans' as mechanism with a case in which the auction followed the repeal.
edges.repair_label: If the higher gate that writes a must-take must itself buy money, at the auction or at its own redemption window, then the holders of its paper price the writ, and the writ is repealed when that price turns against it, as the silver purchases were repealed when the gold that redeemed the Treasury's notes ran low, and the bond sales that refilled it followed the repeal rather than forcing it; the writ's lapse is decided wherever the crown buys money and not in the mine.

edges.why: 'if two are, the extraction collapses to zero' has a documented counterexample: when two complete disc proposals were in the room in 1995 the camps merged their specifications, pooled their patents, and extracted together. The commissioned-rival strategy the label recommends fails whenever the rival can be pooled, and the label should carry that condition, since it is the whole of what the map's own unresolved seed turns on.
edges.repair_label: If the stamp is expiring and one complete proposal is in the room, the stamp buys that proposal on its author's terms; if two are, the compulsion to stamp survives and the extraction collapses, unless the two authors pool, as the two disc camps did in 1995 and extracted together, so a rival proposal is worth more to the body than to its author only while it cannot be pooled, and a body that wants its stamp cheap must commission a rival its sole author cannot absorb.

edges.why: The loop is authored without a case (no port has bought Savannah), but each step follows from the two items' own text: a bought bypass makes the queue captive, a captive queue costs the gate nothing and lengthens, and a long queue is what a bypass is built against. Kept as a conditional claim; it should not be read as documented.
A real fork with a failing antecedent (a marketplace whose buyers count listings buys sellers); a bare sequence puts the two side by side and conceals that they are alternatives.
Real compounding with a real failing antecedent (a gate with its own laboratory can afford its written no); the drug regulator is the case where both hold.

modality_problems: Crown at the auction: 'which is to say into inflation' promotes a contested claim to fact; central-bank purchase of sovereign paper is not the same event as inflation and was not for most of 2009 to 2020. Repaired.

Crown → Must-take edge: 'the writ is repealed on the day the auction leans' is stated as mechanism with a case in which the repeal (November 1893) preceded the bond sales (1894 to 1895); the gold drained at the redemption window. Repaired.
Built to be bought: 'must buy each credible bypass' omits copying, the escape the gate most often takes, and so overstates the compulsion and misprices the extraction. Repaired.
Stamp → Spec edge: 'the extraction collapses to zero' is contradicted by patent pooling between rival proposals. Repaired.
Tenure by consumption: the water-right case has no seller and no extraction; 'the thirsty crop' is not a party. Repaired.
Queue → Built to be bought loop: authored with no case; acceptable as a conditional claim but should not be read as observed.
Seriation note: 'along this stretch the seller's extraction is postponed rather than destroyed' contradicts the Spec item's own text. Noted under seriation.
duplication: No grown list is duplicated as a whole. Papered house partially overlaps what-a-price-does' Price for the stranger's eyes (the gate buys the evidence a non-party reader will count; the ledger rejected the gallery case on exactly this ground and then admitted the theatre case), repaired by a discriminator that names the difference (bodies counted versus a number recorded). Shelf bought first is adjacent to deal-flow-attractors' Shelf that draws both sides and is discriminated properly. Hour that must be manned is discriminated properly against Awake at the hour. Borrowed eyes borders witness-architectures' Silence priced as guilt and the ledger carries the opening.
best_unresolved_seed: The un-poolable rival. The map's own seed is the body that commissions a second proposal to destroy its sole author's extraction without losing its compulsion to adopt; the 1995 disc merger shows the failure mode, two authors who pool and extract as one. The live question is what makes a commissioned rival un-poolable (a different licensing regime, a royalty-free charter, an author with nothing to cross-license), and whether the same construction works at every gate on the map that buys from a sole seller: a second agency for the night shift, a second sponsor-independent trial, a second dealer syndicate. Next to it sits the mirror map this one implies, tollgates that must sell, with the clearinghouse default auction as the case where a gate is compelled to buy and to sell to the same passers on the same day.
independent_review_line: Fable critic: admitted after widening the of-sentence to match the map's own boundary claim (four items buy from suppliers who pass no gate), repairing five items (a seller-less case, an inflation promotion, an omitted copy escape, two missing discriminators including the two closest items that never faced each other), and repairing three edge labels whose cases did not demonstrate their antecedents; nothing cut.
